overview_description.description: Decentro is a full‑stack API banking platform that simplifies financial product integration through modular APIs and SDKs. It offers payment capabilities—including virtual accounts, UPI gateway, recurring payments, instant payouts, escrow accounts, ledgers—and banking services like KYC, identity verification, data aggregation, and fraud detection tools. Businesses use the platform to integrate, develop, and deploy fintech offerings quickly by leveraging pre‑built modules that abstract away direct bank integrations and compliance tasks. Its developer hub provides thorough documentation, sandbox environments, and clear guides to support onboarding across its payment and banking modules.

product.name: API Banking Platform
product.description: A modular API platform enabling businesses to integrate various banking and financial services such as payments, account management, and lending workflows.

product.name: KYC APIs
product.description: APIs for real-time customer and partner identity verification using various national documents to automate onboarding and compliance.

product.name: Virtual Accounts
product.description: Virtual bank accounts that enable real-time transaction reconciliation and tracking of payment sources for businesses.

product.name: Payments APIs
product.description: APIs supporting multiple payment methods including UPI, NEFT, IMPS, RTGS, QR codes, and payment links for instant fund transfers and collections.

product.name: Ledgers API
product.description: An API to automate bookkeeping by managing sales, purchase, and general ledger accounts with real-time reconciliation and transaction tracking.

product.name: Prepaid Payment Instruments (Co-branded Cards & Wallets)
product.description: Physical and virtual co-branded prepaid cards and wallets issued to customers or partners for controlled spending and payments.
